status.description: Overall completion status of the assigned task.

summary.description: Concise 2-5 sentence summary of what was implemented or why the task stopped.

files_changed.description: List of created, modified, or deleted file paths relative to the working directory.

commands_run.description: Key build, lint, or test commands executed along with their brief outcome.

tests_summary.description: Summary of test and verification outcomes, or 'not run' with the reason.

open_issues.description: Remaining risks, caveats, assumptions, or blockers requiring Gemini review.
